New player here I got e-1 pontos someone said to get e-3 and then pull on corposant shall I do that or save or pull on another unit??

Welcome aboard 😄

Pontos and Corpo do work well together ( and you can throw in Saya for a laugh ) but there's no guarentee you will enjoy the gameplay.

I suggest you go through the trials ( " records " button, last section ) for every awakener you take a fancy to.
Trouble with Corpo ( and Saya, Pollux, Helot:Catena ) is they all rely quite a bit on the enlightenmet ( i.e. pulling duplicates ).
Up to you to check what  you want to go for, just now once they're gone you won't likely see them again for several month.

Either way, I highly recommand you take some time to try all four realms before you commit.

Quick reminder : luminous cores can be hoarded ( slowly though, these are rare ) but etheral core turn into pure cores when a new version is released. And the next one is due very soon.

> Luminous cores and etheral cores : access to lilited awakeners

> Pure cores : access to standard awakeners ( standard doesn't mean weaker in some cases )
